# entomo

> entomo is the agentic intelligence platform for performance and skills, powering 30M+ users across
> enterprises and governments. entomo.ai is the platform; axon is the intelligence behind it; Enzo is the
> AI co-worker inside it; TMRW is entomo's national talent transformation platform.

Canonical site: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/
Every figure on this site is drawn from entomo's published record for that client.

## platform
- [entomo | the agentic intelligence platform for work](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/index.html): agentic intelligence that coaches every employee and advises every leader across performance, skills and growth. powering 30M+ users worldwide.
- [entomo axon | the intelligence behind entomo.ai](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/AI-lab/entomo-axon.html): axon is the intelligence behind entomo.ai. it connects what every role requires with what every person brings, into one model of how work gets done.
- [Enzo | the AI co-worker inside entomo.ai](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/AI-lab/enzo.html): Enzo is the AI co-worker inside entomo.ai: 28 capabilities across six pillars of the employee journey, every one grounded in axon.
- [From Skills to Employability](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/Home/national-talent-transformation-v2.html): From skills to employability at national scale. TMRW by entomo is the digital infrastructure that operationalises national skills frameworks — connecting skills, learning, credentials, jobs, and mobility into one workforce ecosystem that delivers measurable employment outcomes.
- [DIA, the data intelligence assistant](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/dia.html): DIA is entomo's data intelligence assistant: ask any workforce question in plain language and get a board-ready recommendation, not a chart.

## solutions
- [competency framework creation](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/competency-framework-creation.html): build a living competency framework on axon: AI market intelligence, 4,000+ pre-built roles, proficiency levels and expert sign-off.
- [employee engagement platform](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/engagement-intelligence.html): continuous employee engagement and culture: agentic intelligence that listens to your workforce, celebrates contributions and surfaces signals for leaders.
- [employee engagement and retention](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/engagement-retention.html): keep your best people: continuous listening, sentiment and burnout signals in real time, and the recognition, mentorship and growth paths that retain them.
- [enterprise performance management office](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/epmo.html): an enterprise performance management office as advisory plus platform: every KPI aligned from strategy map to individual scorecard, kept continuous by AI.
- [hire to retire platform](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/hire-to-retire.html): one employee journey: agentic intelligence that unifies recruitment, onboarding, payroll, attendance and exit into one experience for HR and employees.
- [internal mobility](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/internal-mobility.html): internal mobility on entomo: career paths computed from skill adjacency, opportunities matched to skills and aspirations, and succession driven by skills.
- [learning ROI](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/learning-roi.html): learning curated to the gap, not the catalogue: entomo targets learning at assessment-verified skill gaps and verifies the proficiency change afterwards.
- [AI performance management](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/performance-intelligence.html): close the gap between goals and execution: agentic intelligence that coaches every employee, equips every manager and surfaces performance signals live.
- [skills intelligence for careers and learning](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/skill-intelligence.html): skills intelligence that maps what your workforce has, validates it against what roles require, and grows the capability the gap reveals. built on axon.
- [strategic performance management office](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/spmo.html): build and run a strategic performance management office: balanced scorecards, strategy maps and a KPI cascade from corporate strategy to every scorecard.
- [strategic workforce planning](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/strategic-planning.html): project workforce demand and talent supply, surface the gap by role, model the scenarios, and get a build, buy, borrow or bot recommendation for every gap.
- [succession planning](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/succession-planning.html): succession planning with agentic AI: critical roles risk-scored, successor readiness scored on evidence, nine-box calibration and ready-now talent pools.
- [employee wellbeing intelligence](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/wellness-intelligence.html): protect your people's wellbeing: agentic intelligence that senses wellness signals early, nudges proactively, and acts before stress becomes attrition.
- [workforce analytics and reporting](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-analytics.html): workforce analytics you can ask in plain language: decision-ready answers, ISO 30414-aligned human capital reporting and market benchmarks.
- [workforce assessments at scale](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-assessments.html): skill assessments built from the role's axon blueprint, generated with AI, approved by your experts and scored to proficiency. live in weeks, not quarters.
- [workforce insights for leaders](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-insights.html): every workforce question deserves a real answer, not a dashboard: agentic AI that interprets your people data and recommends what to do next.
- [workforce planning](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-planning.html): workforce planning with agentic AI: model demand against strategy, rank skill gaps, compare build, buy, borrow or bot for every need, and score succession.

## research and downloads
- [30 revolutionary ideas for our remote age](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-30-ideas-remote-age.html): thirty ideas from thirty HR and education influencers on what remote work changes permanently.
- [the agentic HR operating model](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-agentic-hr-operating-model.html): what changes when intelligence acts inside the process rather than reporting on it, with a maturity model PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/agentic-hr-operating-model.pdf
- [augmenting human capital management with AI](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-augmenting-hcm-with-ai.html): where talent analytics matures, from reporting to recommendation: a report on augmenting human capital management with AI, written with ETHRWorld.
- [evolution of career readiness: singapore](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-career-readiness-singapore.html): a study of which roles and skills stayed resilient as the singapore career landscape shifted.
- [governing AI in HR: a readiness guide](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-governing-ai-in-hr.html): a readiness guide to the EU AI Act, NYC Local Law 144 and the documentation your HR systems must hold to pass an audit. PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/governing-ai-in-hr.pdf
- [HRTech for best-in-class talent engagement](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-hrtech-talent-engagement.html): a four-part webinar series on the platforms reshaping digital HR, recorded with IHRP Singapore.
- [human capital disclosure: ISO 30414 and CSRD](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-human-capital-disclosure-iso-30414-csrd.html): a metric-by-metric readiness guide to ISO 30414:2025 and the workforce disclosures inside the revised EU standards PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/human-capital-disclosure-iso-30414-csrd.pdf
- [an internal talent marketplace people use](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-internal-talent-marketplace-people-use.html): the operating model, manager incentives and metrics that separate a working marketplace from an empty job board PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/internal-talent-marketplace-people-use.pdf
- [mastering risk and performance in the next normal](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-mastering-risk-and-performance.html): essential practices for enterprises and employees operating across owned, shared and remote workplaces.
- [reform and reimagine workplace practices](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-reform-reimagine-roadmap.html): part two of the returning-to-work roadmap, a self-check across the react, respond, reform and reimagine stages.
- [return to work: a self-assessment for leaders](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-return-to-work-self-assessment.html): part one of the returning-to-work roadmap, built around a yes or no self-check for leadership teams.
- [the skills-based organisation, practically](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-skills-based-organisation-practically.html): a staged first-year guide from role architecture to skills-based staffing, with what to do in each quarter PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/skills-based-organisation-practically.pdf
- [workforce planning when AI changes the work](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/resource-workforce-planning-when-ai-changes-the-work.html): how to model demand and supply when task composition shifts, with a build, buy, borrow, bot matrix PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/workforce-planning-when-ai-changes-the-work.pdf

## writing
- [assessing skills at scale without fooling yourself](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-assessing-skills-at-scale-without-fooling-yourself.html): validity is an argument you build, reliability is the ceiling you cannot exceed, and most internal assessments fail on both.
- [autonomy should be a dial, not a switch](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-autonomy-is-a-dial-not-a-switch.html): a four-level model for governing AI in HR, with what to log at each level and the evidence required to move a use case up.
- [burnout is a job design problem, not a resilience problem](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-burnout-is-a-job-design-problem.html): the evidence points at demands, resources and control, yet most organisations respond by measuring how well people cope with them.
- [career paths people can walk](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-career-paths-people-can-walk.html): career frameworks name destinations and skip the route; paths built from skill distance tell people where they can go next.
- [your engagement survey measures the wrong latency](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-engagement-surveys-measure-the-wrong-latency.html): engagement moves day to day, the annual survey reports once a year, and the gap between those two clocks is where most listening programmes fail.
- [goal quality is measurable, and most goals fail the test](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-goal-quality-is-a-measurable-property.html): a goal nobody can review produces no feedback, and that failure can be scored, sampled and tracked across an entire organisation.
- [internal mobility runs on two clocks](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-internal-mobility-two-clocks.html): one clock fills the role open this month, the other builds the career that takes three years, and most organisations wind only one of them.
- [the job description is the wrong unit of analysis](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-job-description-wrong-unit-of-analysis.html): job titles average away the variation that matters, and the decisions enterprises now face need a smaller unit than the job.
- [learning spend needs a chain of evidence](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-learning-roi-chain-of-evidence.html): training evaluation stops at satisfaction scores because the next four links are unowned, not because they are impossible.
- [your skills taxonomy is a dictionary, not a diagnosis](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-skills-taxonomy-dictionary-not-diagnosis.html): a taxonomy resolves what to call things, and cannot tell you proficiency, context or currency, which is where every workforce decision lives.
- [succession slates need evidence, not ratings](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-succession-readiness-is-evidence.html): nine-box grids produce agreement quickly and accuracy rarely, and a board question will find the difference every time.
- [the workforce report your board and your auditor both accept](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-the-board-ready-workforce-report.html): ISO 30414 became a requirements standard in 2025 and the EU narrowed CSRD in 2026, which changes what a credible disclosure set looks like.
- [the queue between a question and its answer](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-the-queue-between-question-and-answer.html): self-service analytics never removed the wait for workforce answers, because the slow part was never retrieval.
- [why competency frameworks die in month seven](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-why-competency-frameworks-die-in-month-seven.html): role requirements drift faster than any rewrite cycle; a framework survives only if it is maintained monthly like an operating system.
- [workforce planning is a decision, not a spreadsheet](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/inspiration/blog-workforce-planning-is-a-decision-not-a-spreadsheet.html): build, buy, borrow or bot: every capability needs a supply decision on the record, with the evidence that would reverse it.
